items.description: Role metadata (author, description, platforms, dependencies)
items.notes: File already existed and was marked complete; skipped overwrite

items.description: Chef default attributes → Ansible role defaults (sites list, SSL settings, security flags)
Role argument specs for fail-fast parameter validation — generate after defaults/main.yml is written
Handlers for nginx reload/restart, fail2ban restart, sshd restart
Entry point — includes security, nginx, ssl, sites task files in order
items.notes: Fixed: Moved nginx.yml include before security.yml. fail2ban jail.local references /var/log/nginx/* log paths; nginx must be installed first so that directory exists when fail2ban starts watching it.

items.description: Security hardening: fail2ban, ufw firewall rules, sysctl kernel hardening, SSH hardening
items.notes: Fixed: (1) Moved 'Enable and start fail2ban' to after 'Deploy fail2ban jail configuration' — service was starting before its config was in place. (2) Added openssh-server to package installs — lineinfile tasks modify /etc/ssh/sshd_config but the package was never installed.

items.description: Install openssl/ca-certificates, create ssl-cert group, create SSL dirs, generate self-signed certs for all 3 sites
Install nginx, deploy nginx.conf and security.conf, manage service, create document roots and static files
items.notes: No changes needed. nginx package is installed first (creates www-data user and /var/log/nginx), then config is deployed, then service is started. Document root parent /opt/server is created implicitly by ansible.builtin.file state=directory which creates all intermediate dirs; leaf dirs are correctly owned by www-data.

items.description: Deploy per-site nginx vhost configs, create sites-enabled symlinks, remove default site
Global nginx configuration (worker_processes, connections, gzip, includes)
fail2ban jail configuration — 5 jails: DEFAULT, sshd, nginx-http-auth, nginx-limit-req, nginx-botsearch
Nginx security snippet — server_tokens, rate limit zones, buffer sizes, SSL globals, cipher suite
Per-site nginx vhost config — HTTP→HTTPS redirect, SSL, HSTS, security headers, logging; rendered 3 times (test/ci/status)
Kernel sysctl security parameters — IP spoofing, ICMP, source routing, SYN flood, IPv6 disable
Static landing page for ci.cluster.local — deployed to /opt/server/ci/index.html (owner www-data, mode 0644)
Static landing page for test.cluster.local — deployed to /opt/server/test/index.html (owner www-data, mode 0644)
Static landing page for status.cluster.local — deployed to /opt/server/status/index.html (owner www-data, mode 0644)
Molecule scenario configuration — delegated driver, local connection (not docker/podman)
Molecule converge playbook — runs the role via a single ansible.builtin.include_role task
items.notes: Generated converge.yml with single include_role task for nginx_multisite

items.notes: Generated verify.yml split into 6 plays covering services, nginx configs, vhosts, document roots, SSL certs, ports, HTTP connectivity, fail2ban, sysctl, and SSH hardening
